report.method: Leave-one-participant-out; fixed random forest without tuning. Non-overlapping 30-second windows within a single stimulus, video IDs 1–8. Four classes from mean participant valence and arousal ratings split at 5, not stimulus category. Training excludes every window from the tested participant.
limitations: Exploratory small laboratory sample; no clinical or astronaut validation.
Quadrants do not uniquely identify anger, fear, happiness, anxiety or depression.
Requires the specified EDA, skin-temperature and facial-EMG window features.
Votes are uncalibrated, not probabilities of mental disorders.
Interactive manual feature values are hypothetical scenarios, not measured emotion.
